universities.notes: International applicants may be interviewed on mathematics and foreign-language proficiency; fees and deadlines are not published on the international page. [Source](https://innmanagement.tsue.uz/en/pages/international-applicants)

Foreign bachelor's applicants are assessed by interview; the page gives an application period but does not specify its year. [Source](https://www.ablaikhan.kz/en/for-applicants/for-applicants/international_students.html)

tuition.detail: International bachelor's tuition starts at 650,000 KZT; valid for 2025/26 only.

universities.notes: Applicants may be admitted without a language certificate based on interview results. [Source](https://global.tou.edu.kz/faq)
Foreign applicants seeking paid study are admitted by interview during the calendar year. [Source](https://yu.edu.kz/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/pravila-priema-10.06.2022.pdf)
